verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display and control app, so per-device permission scoping is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows device pairing and removal, plus clipboard and input features that are always on. Nothing documents limiting a paired device to view-only, control, clipboard or file access, and pairing or removal is an adjacent control, not permission scoping.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
